needed.evidence: The left side of the road is bordered by a yellow-painted curb and a dense, unbroken line of trees and bushes, with no visible path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway along the left side of the road, separated from the carriageway by a grass verge or a physical barrier.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road consists of a grassy verge and trees, with no designated path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway along the right side of the road, separated from the carriageway by a grass verge or a physical barrier.

needed.evidence: The road is a wide, multi-lane street with no visible pedestrian crossing facilities, such as a zebra crossing or a signalised crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to allow safe crossing of the multiple lanes.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers, especially at night.
